scientific_integrity: The collision identity is proved directly from two explicit base-\(b\) digit expansions. Squarefreeness is reduced to coprimality of the three linear factors, and the density bound follows from an elementary union bound over prime-square divisibility classes. Finite computation is used only as regression evidence.
scientific_limitations: The result proves squarefree noninjectivity only for a positive-density set of bases satisfying simultaneous squarefreeness of \(b\), \(b-2\), and \(2b-3\); it does not settle every base \(b\ge11\).
title: A positive-density squarefree collision family for digit-sum products
